judged_text: deleteEvent has the same dead fallback: inside the `externalCalendarId ? ... : find(cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` branch, externalCalendarId is falsy so find always returns undefined. Cancelling a booking whose calendar reference has no externalCalendarId silently fails to delete the Google event (calendarId=undefined), leaving orphaned events on users' calendars.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` introduce an illogical fallback: `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. In the `:` branch, `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so the `.find(...)` compares `cal.externalId === undefined` and will always return `undefined` in normal cases. This means when `externalCalendarId` is not provided, the code will not select any destination calendar externalId (unlike the prior behavior which used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`), causing the operation to target the wrong calendar (likely falling back elsewhere to "primary") and potentially leaving events undeleted/unchanged.
